title: Save & recall U1/U2 banks

steps.text: Dial in everything first — mode, aperture, shutter, ISO, WB, AF, metering
MENU → Setup menu (wrench) → Save user settings → Save to U1 (or U2) → Yes
To recall: rotate the mode dial to U1 or U2 — every saved setting snaps back
Eclipse plan: U1 = filtered partials, U2 = totality base. One click at C2.

tip: Changes made while shooting in U1/U2 are temporary — the bank reloads on recall. Re-save to keep them.
